title: Dead Labrador Nelly photographed as a ball of light after a Cape Canaveral launch trip
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Dead Labrador Nelly photographed as a ball of light after a Cape Canaveral launch trip, about after 2007 at Cape Canaveral, Florida; Fayetteville, North Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Cape Canaveral, Florida; Fayetteville, North Carolina

tellings.quote: And she comes up out of her grave in a little ball of light. and I took that picture and that's how I got that.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says strange lights and craft appear around him and that NASA has studied him, told podcast host Jesse Michels about his dead Labrador, Nelly. He says that after a trip to see a rocket launch at Cape Canaveral, Florida, around 2007, he photographed her rising from her grave in North Carolina as a small ball of light, and that is how he got the picture, which appears in his book UFO of God. To him it would mean something of a living being carries on after death.
